records.display_title: feat(auth): complete firebase auth ui integration and supporting tooling

head_commit.message:
feat(auth): complete firebase auth ui integration and supporting tooling

Add the full set of auth screens/forms (sign-in, sign-up, phone, MFA,
OAuth, forgot-password), auth hooks, and the firebase client/emulator
setup that ADR 0008-0011 describe, plus guard scripts for component
props and RSC boundaries, the ask-matt/setup-matt-pocock-skills agent
skills, and doc sync (AGENTS, ARCHITECTURE, CONTEXT, exec-plans).

Fixes type-unsafe prop spreading in the sign-in/sign-up/email-link/
forgot-password screen wrappers: they forwarded the whole div-typed
rest-props bag (including ref and all DOM event handlers) into their
inner form components, which expect ComponentProps<"form">. Now each
screen forwards only the specific callback props its form accepts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
feat(firebase): vendor Firebase UI shadcn components unmodified

Download all 30 components of the official Firebase UI `@firebase` shadcn
registry (v7.1.0) byte-for-byte into src/components/firebase/ and move the
earlier root-level firebase files under src/.

- resolve sibling imports via an `@/components/*` tsconfig path fallback so
  no vendored file is edited
- treat the folder as upstream: Biome ignore, tsc exclude, Knip entry
- append the registry's provider-button theme CSS to globals.css
- add @firebase-oss/ui-react, @firebase-oss/ui-core (undeclared by the
  registry), react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers; bump firebase to ^12 to
  satisfy the ui-react peer range
- deny optional build scripts (@firebase/util, protobufjs) so pnpm install
  exits cleanly
- renumber the ADR to 0008 (0001 was taken) and rewrite it

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
